title: playanimation
description: Makes one or more entities play a one-off animation.

entity.title: entity
entity.description: Required. A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the entity.

animation.title: animation
animation.description: Required. A `string` that is a single word or quoted `string`  that refers to an animation name or an animation JSON file in a resource pack.

controller.title: controller
controller.description: Optional. A `string` that is an animation controller name or a new file defined in a resource pack.
